TextbookHub

Easy textbook buying and selling for university students

AI-Powered Price Suggestions

Provides users with accurate price suggestions for their textbooks to ensure fair transactions

Instant Delivery Coordination

Automates the delivery process between buyers and sellers, ensuring textbooks are delivered quickly and efficiently

Secure Payment Processing

Ensures secure and seamless payment transactions between buyers and sellers

User Profile Management

Allows users to create and manage their profiles, including posting textbooks for sale and searching for textbooks

Campus-Wide Integration

Integrates with university databases and systems to provide users with access to textbook information and sales data

Rating and Review System

Allows users to rate and review their transactions, helping to build trust and credibility within the community

Push Notifications

Provides users with push notifications for new listings, sale offers, and delivery updates
